fields.why: Vaccination status, the exposure, was verified from "EMR, state-based registries, vaccination cards, or self-report" as part of IVY's own data collection; the brief folds a network's own chart abstraction into sentinel/network but does not say whether registry lookups done by the network count separately. Rule that would decide it: external record systems a network queries to set exposure status are listed in their own right (or are not), stated once.

brief_issues: data_source_type: say whether registries or other external records a sentinel network consults to verify vaccination status are listed separately (COVID-NET IIS linkage in mm7134a3 was listed by both readers; IVY's verification here split them).
